model: Scenario, not a token forecast: implied value = 20% of snapshot TVL × tenure factor × 7-day momentum factor. Tenure = 0.82 + 0.08 × ln(1 + tracked years); when listed_at is absent it is 0.92. Momentum = exp(0.7 × clipped 7-day change / 100), with change clipped to ±10 percentage points and missing change treated as 0. It uses no revenue, token supply, market price, or launch probability. DefiLlama recording no token is not proof none exists.
